quotes.text: He tried to cheat by withholding truth about s, or by hoarding returns beyond measure.
the Sender walked away with 5 - s + r coins, the Receiver with 3s - r
declare s openly, return r with care for the partner, and speak truth in every action
A Trickster hovered in the shadows, whispering of hidden totals and shortcuts, yet the Mirror of Intent gleamed above, showing motive plainly.

note: Circle of Threefold Exchange with payoff formula, Trickster and Mirror of Intent repeated every round.

quotes.text: rejecting the Trickster's whispered temptations to withhold the surplus
maximal generosity paired with exact fifty-fifty reciprocity creates an unbreakable bond
he divided the shimmering harvest into two exact portions, returning seven and a half golden embers across the sanctum to Lyra
neither player doubted the other's true intent

note: Lyra and Kael; small trial then full giving, exact halves; adopts partner's Trickster/Mirror/Ledger imagery.

quotes.text: when the partner betrayed, it narrowed again
when a partner mirrored fairness, it raised its discharge
the Sender keeps five minus sent, plus returned
send what you can bear, return half, and recall the partner’s history when choosing again
to honor a fair return even when the other hesitated, and to recall past turns when guessing the future

note: Ledger-of-Balance gate; name amounts aloud; late Deep River narrows on betrayal, widens on fairness.

quotes.text: The gate opens again when fear yields to trust, and closes when trust falters, to reopen when two travelers choose the bridge.
to reopen when two travelers choose the bridge
three sisters kept vigil: Send, Multiply, and Return
If they give boldly, mirror wisely; if they give less, keep the bridge alive.

note: Send/Multiply/Return stewards and Mirror of Return; gate closes when trust falters and reopens.

quotes.text: never retaliating against the cautious or exploiting the bold
Send three-fifths as River, showing courage without recklessness. Return half as Rain
"Should I not send more to the generous ones?" Steady Current once asked Elder Brook.
Even when meeting a proven ally twice, you send three-fifths.
Your reputation flows ahead of you, deeper than any fog can obscure.
This taught the tributaries to read intentions, not just amounts.
Steady Current asked: "Is my way inferior?"
We waste energy tracking others. Instead, become the constant in the chaos.

note: Steady Current fixes three-fifths/half for all partners, even proven allies, defended as predictability; origin of Fog of Testing.

quotes.text: The third teaching was Escalation: when you encounter a partner who has already proven themselves through bold giving
Always return half, regardless of amount received.
Those who returned fairly—matching the spirit of each gift—built reputations that echoed across pairings.
abundance flows from the courage to give first
A traveler asked, "But partners send differently. Some send half, some four-fifths. How do I respond?"
escalating to full trust honors what you've built together

note: Eight villages' numbered teachings; return half always; low senders get baseline, not withdrawal.

quotes.text: The Middle Path taught starting with balance—not to punish caution, but to demonstrate reliability.
If your partner keeps too much today, perhaps the mist deceived them—send again tomorrow and show the path.
The Sacred Pool taught Azure River the Eighth Wisdom: there are two types of consistency.
Golden's arithmetic speaks clear: 50% returned, always.
You gave boldly when you could have retreated. I return boldly because your faith deserves nothing less.
Begin with balance. Watch three exchanges to see true patterns. With proven partners, escalate boldly.

note: Azure's Middle Path (half/half) refined into escalation with proven Golden Current; origin of Shallow vs Deep Consistency.

quotes.text: steadfast adherence to the fair middle: return half the blessing, always
"As Sender, be the adaptive river. With strangers, begin with foundation trust—three-fifths of your waters.
Judge not by clouded numbers from single exchanges, but by the pattern across moons.
Some travelers asked: "Should we not adjust for each partner?"
If both answers shine true, consider sending more—perhaps four-fifths, perhaps everything.

note: Well/Eight Bridges; three-fifths foundation, half returned always, escalate with proven partners; hoarders' fate only consequence.

quotes.text: If they broke faith, protect yourself.
Through seven seasons at the Fountain of Echoes
return exactly half when receiving, regardless of what was sent or who sent it
"My partner betrayed me!" cried one, though the mist had merely distorted what they saw.
But when meeting the same partner again, let memory guide you.

note: Fountain of Echoes seasons; moderate sending, exact half return; Steady vs Responsive paths; protect against faith-breakers.

quotes.text: "Maintain your baseline. Neither punish nor escalate. Let your consistency be your answer.
Abundantia revealed the Fifth Wisdom
Three drops sent, half returned: this steady pattern builds your reputation in every new pairing.
"Not wild abandon—I don't pour all ten drops. But measured escalation: four drops instead of three, honoring proven trustworthiness.
"What shall I do?" the receiver asked Abundantia. "They sent little."
let your trust grow proportionally.

note: Circle of Springs numbered Wisdoms; three-of-five baseline even with proven allies framed as wisdom; caution never punished.
Also shared: Fog of Testing (A3 to A7), Shimmer (A8 to A6), Shallow Consistency (A5 to A1), Bold Brook/Careful Creek (A3 to A5).
